{#- Language switcher for the sidebar. ``language_editions`` is built per page by ``_shared_conf.setup``: the current edition is a plain ````, the other one a link to the counterpart page, falling back to that edition's top page when the page has no counterpart yet. The control carries no visible caption: a word in either language is opaque to readers of the other one, so the globe stands in for it and the options name themselves in their own language. ``language_caption`` remains as the accessible name, which assistive tech announces in the page's language. A link that falls back to the other edition's top page carries only a ``title``. It gets no visible marker: the landing page says it is under construction, so warning about it beforehand would cost a glyph nobody has a legend for. -#} {%- if language_editions %}
{%- for edition in language_editions %} {%- if edition.url %} {{ edition.label }} {%- else %} {{ edition.label }} {%- endif %} {%- endfor %}
{%- endif %}
